```{r Import Libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
# library(data.table)
# library(stringi)
library(tsibble)
library(tibbletime)

# note: I prefer the package tsibble which includes some new features. tibbletime is actually retired. but tsibble was having trouble parsing the time column for some reason. it is more tempermental. there is also a timetk package I haven't used as much
```

# Files from various SCADA databases and instruments
## 2011 - 2021
```{r Read in SCADA files from 2011-2021}
# file path to folder containing old scada database 2011-2021 ocean water quality files
path <- "/Users/grambihler/Documents/Data/GitHub/OceanWaterQuality/YSIExoSonde/YSI-sonde-raw-data/SCADA/SCADA-2011-2021"

# data from 7/22/11 - 8/4/14
ocean_data_2011_2014 <- read_csv(here(path, "Ocean_FTP_Data - pre 2014-8-11.csv"),
                                 skip = 1,
                                 col_names = c("datetime",
                                               "temp_f",
                                               "temp_c",
                                               "pH",
                                               "salinity_psu",
                                               "conductivity_uScm",
                                               "orp_mV")) %>%
  mutate(conductivity_uScm = conductivity_uScm*1000) %>%
  na.omit()%>%
  filter(!orp_mV == -999 & !orp_mV == 0) %>%
  add_column(chlorophyll_ugL = NA,
             .after = 7)

# data from 10/3/14 - 6/12/18
ocean_data_2014_2018 <- read_csv(here(path, "Ocean_FTP_Data.csv"), 
                                 skip = 1,
                                 col_names = c("datetime",
                                               "temp_f",
                                               "temp_c",
                                               "pH",
                                               "salinity_psu",
                                               "conductivity_uScm",
                                               "orp_mV")) %>%
  mutate(conductivity_uScm = conductivity_uScm*1000) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  filter(!orp_mV == -999 & !orp_mV == 0) %>%
  add_column(chlorophyll_ugL = NA,
             .after = 7)

# data from 11/18/16 - 6/12/18
ocean_data_2016_2018 <- read_csv(here(path, "Ocean_FTP_Data_Extended.csv"), 
                                 skip = 1,
                                 col_names = c("datetime",
                                               "temp_f",
                                               "temp_c",
                                               "pH",
                                               "salinity_psu",
                                               "conductivity_uScm",
                                               "orp_mV",
                                               "total_algae_rfu",
                                               "chlorophyll_ugL",
                                               "ro_flow_gpm")) %>%
  mutate(conductivity_uScm = conductivity_uScm*1000)%>%
  na.omit() %>%
  filter(!orp_mV == -999 & !orp_mV == 0)

# data from 10/12/18 - 5/25/21
ocean_data_2018_2021 <- read_csv(here(path, "Ocean_Data_new.csv"), 
                                 skip = 1, 
                                 col_names = c("datetime",
                                               "temp_c",
                                               "pH",
                                               "salinity_psu",
                                               "conductivity_uScm",
                                               "orp_mV",
                                               "total_algae_cellsL",
                                               "chlorophyll_ugL",
                                               "do_saturated_percent"))%>%
  mutate(conductivity_uScm = conductivity_uScm*1000)%>%
  na.omit() %>%
  add_column(temp_f = NA, .after = 1)

```

# Data Wrangling
```{r Wrangle and combine data frames}
# create pre-2019 ocean data dataframe
OceanDataFame_2011_2021 <- rbind(ocean_data_2011_2014, 
                              ocean_data_2014_2018,
                              ocean_data_2016_2018[,c(1:7,9)],
                              ocean_data_2018_2021[,c(1:7,9)])%>%
  left_join(ocean_data_2016_2018)%>%
  left_join(ocean_data_2018_2021)

# create old database YSI dataframe by joining the files for each variable from this instrument based on the datetime column
OlddbYsiFrame <- olddb_ysi_temp_c %>%
  left_join(olddb_ysi_pH) %>%
  left_join(olddb_ysi_salinity) %>%
  left_join(olddb_ysi_conductivity) %>%
  left_join(olddb_ysi_orp) %>%
  left_join(olddb_ysi_total_algae) %>%
  left_join(olddb_ysi_chlorophyll)

# create old database YSI EXO3 dataframe by joining the files for each variable from this instrument based on the datetime column
OlddbYsiExoFrame <- olddb_exo_temp_c %>%
  left_join(olddb_exo_ph) %>%
  left_join(olddb_exo_salinity) %>%
  left_join(olddb_exo_conductivity) %>%
  left_join(olddb_exo_orp) %>%
  left_join(olddb_exo_total_algae) %>%
  left_join(olddb_exo_chlorophyll) %>%
  left_join(olddb_exo_do) %>%
  left_join(olddb_exo_do_local) %>%
  left_join(olddb_exo_do_saturated) %>%
  left_join(olddb_exo_nlf_conductivity) %>%
  left_join(olddb_exo_ph_mv) %>%
  left_join(olddb_exo_sp_conductivity) %>%
  left_join(olddb_exo_temp_f) %>%
  left_join(olddb_exo_total_dissolved_solids)

# create new database YSI EXO3 dataframe by joining the files for each variable from this instrument based on the datetime column
NewdbYsiExoFrame <- newdb_exo_temp_c %>%
  left_join(newdb_exo_ph) %>%
  left_join(newdb_exo_salinity) %>%
  left_join(newdb_exo_conductivity) %>%
  left_join(newdb_exo_orp) %>%
  left_join(newdb_exo_total_algae) %>%
  left_join(newdb_exo_chlorophyll) %>%
  left_join(newdb_exo_do) %>%
  left_join(newdb_exo_do_local) %>%
  left_join(newdb_exo_do_saturated) %>%
  left_join(newdb_exo_nlf_conductivity) %>%
  left_join(newdb_exo_ph_mv) %>%
  left_join(newdb_exo_sp_conductivity) %>%
  left_join(newdb_exo_temp_f) %>%
  left_join(newdb_exo_total_dissolved_solids)

# create dataframe of all YSI Exo3 Sonde data
YsiExoFrame <- rbind(OlddbYsiExoFrame, NewdbYsiExoFrame)

# create dataframe of all YSI Sonde data -- 10/21/19-present
YsiFrame <- rbind(OlddbYsiFrame[,1:6], YsiExoFrame[,1:6]) %>%
  left_join(OlddbYsiFrame) %>%
  left_join(YsiExoFrame)

# create dataframe of all data -- 2011-present
# edit column placement of YsiFrame to match up common columns with OceanDataFrame_2011_2021 
YsiFrameEdit <- YsiFrame %>%
  relocate(temp_f, .before = temp_c) %>%
  relocate(chlorophyll_ugL, total_algae_rfu, .after = orp_mV) %>%
  add_column(ro_flow_gpm = NA, .after = 9) %>%
  relocate(do_saturated_percent, .after = total_algae_cellsL)
# combine dataframes, keep unique rows, move columns around so that similar variables are grouped together
OceanWaterQualityFrame <- rbind(OceanDataFame_2011_2021, YsiFrameEdit[, 1:12]) %>%
  left_join(YsiFrameEdit) %>%
  unique() %>%
  relocate(pH_mV, .after = pH) %>%
  relocate(nlf_conductivity_uScm, 
           sp_conductivity_uScm, .after = conductivity_uScm) %>%
  relocate(do_mgL, 
           do_saturated_percent, 
           do_local_percent, .after = sp_conductivity_uScm) %>%
  relocate(chlorophyll_rfu, .after = orp_mV) %>%
  relocate(ro_flow_gpm, .after = total_dissolved_solids_mgL)%>%
  mutate(datetime = ymd_hms(datetime))

#create a time tibble
OceanWaterQualityTibble <- OceanWaterQualityFrame %>%
  as_tbl_time(index = datetime)
#order by day
OceanWaterQualityTibble <- OceanWaterQualityTibble %>% 
  arrange(ymd_hms(datetime))

```


# Preliminary Plotting
```{r Basic plots - pre QC}
# create long format dataframe
OceanWaterQualityFramePivot <- OceanWaterQualityFrame %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = temp_f:ro_flow_gpm,
               names_to = "variables",
               values_to = "variable_values")

# line graph of every variable - facet wrapped 
AllVariablesPlot <- OceanWaterQualityFramePivot %>%
  mutate(date = date(datetime))%>%
  group_by(date, variables) %>%
  summarise(mean_daily_value = mean(variable_values, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  na.omit(mean_daily_value) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, 
             y = mean_daily_value)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~variables, ncol = 3, scales = "free")+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(.5, .5))) +
  scale_x_date(breaks = waiver(), date_breaks = "1 year") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45))+
  ggtitle("B2O Water Quality by Variable from 2011-2023")

AllVariablesPlot
  
```


# Original code from Dan (and Renee) for EXO3 files -- can be ignored
```{r Read in and format UTF-16 files}
#file path for your data directory. might work with the "Box Sync" client as well, haven't tried
path16 <- "/Users/grambihler/Documents/Data/GitHub/OceanWaterQuality/YSIExoSonde/YSI-sonde-raw-data/UTF-16-versions" 

# create ExoFrame16: use path to create list of UTF-16 files to read in, read in files in path, specify column data types, skip the first 9 rows, and specify UTF-16 encoding for files from YSI exo sonde
ExoFrame16 <- list.files(path = path16,
                       pattern = ".csv") %>%
            map_df(~read_csv(.,
                             col_types = cols(.default = col_double(),
                                              `Date (MM/DD/YYYY)` = col_date(format = '%m/%d/%Y'),
                                              `Site Name` = col_character(),
                                              `Time (HH:mm:ss)` = col_time(format = "%H:%M:%S")),
                             skip = 9,
                             locale=locale(encoding="UTF-16")))
```

```{r File Formatting}
files <- list.files(pattern = ".csv") #create list of files in directory

#bind files into a list. skips the first 8 lines (EXO summary data). creates a column noting the source file of each entry
exolist<-Map(cbind, lapply(files, fread,sep=",",skip=8), filename = files) 

#fread function can't work with the files as they come out of YSI (in UTF-16 format). 
#I had to re-save them in Excel to change them to UTF-8. The YSI outputs should either be converted in bulk in the future, or maybe there's a setting in the KorEXO template.

```

```{r Data Wrangling}
#bind list entries into single merged data frame
exodata <- rbindlist(exolist,use.names=TRUE,fill=TRUE) 

#rename columns to easier names
colnames(exodata)<-c("Date","Time","Time.fracsec","Sitename","Chlor.RFU","Cond.uScm",
                     "nLF.Cond.uScm","DO.percsat","DO.perclocal","DO.mgL","ORP.mV",
                     "S.PSU","SpCond.uScm","TAL.PE.RFU","TDS.mgL","Wiperpos.V",
                     "pH","pH.mV","TempC","BattV","CablepwrV","filename") 

#I find that R does best when you break up the date column into its parts and put them back together into a date
#break date into its parts
exodata <- exodata %>%
  separate(Date,c("Month","Day","Year"),sep="/") 

#break time into its parts
exodata <- exodata %>%
  separate(Time,c("Hour","Minute","Second"))

#paste them together again and make a date
exodata$Datetime <- ymd_hms(paste(exodata$Year,exodata$Month,exodata$Day,
                                  " ",exodata$Hour,":",exodata$Minute,":",exodata$Second))

#create a date column again
exodata$Date <- as_date(date(exodata$Datetime))

#remove any duplicate rows
exodata <- distinct(exodata)
#remove any NAs
exodata <- subset(exodata,is.na(exodata$Datetime)==FALSE) 

#make any columns that might be stuck as factors numeric
exodata <- exodata %>% 
  mutate_at(c(9:25), as.numeric) 

#create a time tibble
exotbl <- as_tbl_time(exodata,index=Datetime)

#order by day
exotblm<- exotbl %>% 
  arrange(ymd_hms(exotbl$Datetime)) 
```

```{r Data Analysis Syntax Example}
#this syntax can be used to aggregate the data by all sorts of periods including week, hour, etc
exoday<-exotbl %>%
  collapse_by("day") %>%
  group_by(Datetime,Date)%>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

```

```{r Plot Example}
#create plots for data points

ggplot(exoday,aes(Date,DO.mgL))+
ggplot(exoday,aes(Date,pH))+
  geom_point(cex=1,alpha=0.5)+
  ylab(expression(paste("pH")))+
  xlab(element_blank())+
  theme_classic(base_size=20)+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")


```
